pl.releaseNotes:
• New connections: NFS, FTP, FTPES, FTPS, SFTP and WebDAV, with folder browsing, playback and resumable downloads.

CUE albums, richer artwork and smoother disc playback.

• Open CUE albums as individual tracks, with titles, durations and gapless playback.
• Create playlists and download CUE albums without duplicating the audio files.
• Discover more Blu-ray and DVD covers; load large album artwork in the background.
• See available disc audio formats before playback.
• Jump to Blu-ray chapters faster.
• Keep subtitles synchronized when playback resumes after a network interruption.
• Restore folder navigation correctly after editing collection locations.
• Bug fixes and stability improvements.
